self_assessment: High confidence in the AL2023 dates (standard support until 2027-06-30, extended/maintenance until 2029-06-30, corroborated by multiple current AWS-docs-derived sources); the 2025/2027/2029 dates are extrapolated by applying the same +4/+6-year-from-release-year formula since AWS never published fixed dates for those versions (and real-world AL2025 was later cancelled) -- lower confidence on those three, but they follow the cadence AWS had originally announced and match the pattern implied by the issue.
